headline: Tuesday at the lake: Farmers Market day with mild temps and light showers possible
lede: Tuesday, September 29 offers a classic Branson mix — head to the Landing Farmers Market in the afternoon, enjoy the Table Rock bite in the morning, and catch an evening show. High near 82°F with a chance of light rain; perfect for mixing outdoor market browsing with indoor options.

featured.title: Landing Farmers Market
featured.where: Landing south lot by Bass Pro
featured.why: Fresh local produce, crafts, and live music — the Tuesday highlight for first-timers. Pair with a walk along the boardwalk and fountain.

plan.title: Table Rock morning bite
plan.detail: Bass and crappie active in shallows; trout on Taneycomo near generation periods. Lake level ~911.7 ft (3.3 ft below full). Verify current generation schedule.

plan.title: Landing Farmers Market
plan.detail: 2:30–6:30 PM in the south lot by Bass Pro. Fresh finds, food trucks, and Branson vibes.

plan.title: Evening show on the Strip
plan.detail: Catch a reliable performance (Presleys Country Jubilee, Haygoods, or Hamners Variety). Confirm exact times at the box office.

indoor.name: Presleys Country Jubilee
indoor.detail: Classic country music and comedy at 8:00 PM. Family-friendly Branson tradition.

indoor.name: The Haygoods
indoor.detail: High-energy family show with music and lights at Clay Cooper Theatre.

indoor.name: WonderWorks
indoor.detail: Indoor upside-down attraction with hands-on science and magic — great rain backup.
